job.job_description:
Senior Python Backend Engineer
Experience: 5 8 Years
Location: Noida Work From Office (5 Days Initially) Hybrid (Post Observation Period)
Key Responsibilities Develop backend applications using Python. Build REST APIs and microservices using FastAPI, Flask, and Django/DRF. Design scalable, secure, and maintainable software architecture. Build asynchronous processing using Celery, AsyncIO, RabbitMQ, and Kafka. Develop data extraction pipelines for structured and unstructured data. Integrate PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and external REST APIs. Integrate OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Fireworks AI, or similar LLM providers. Implement structured LLM outputs using Pydantic models. Build confidence scoring, validation, retries, audit logging, and robust error handling. Write unit and integration tests using pytest. Participate in code reviews, CI/CD, and deployment activities. Required Technical Skills Programming: Python, SQL, JavaScript (Preferred) Frameworks: FastAPI, Flask, Django, Django REST Framework Backend: REST APIs, Microservices, JWT/OAuth2, AsyncIO, Celery, RabbitMQ, Kafka Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MySQL AI/LLM: OpenAI, Anthropic, Fireworks AI, Prompt Engineering, Pydantic Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Git, Linux, CI/CD, AWS (Preferred) Testing: pytest, Unit Testing, Integration Testing Tools: GitHub/GitLab, Postman, Jira, Swagger/OpenAPI Preferred Qualifications Experience building enterprise AI-enabled backend platforms. Strong understanding of distributed systems and event-driven architecture. Experience with scalable data processing pipelines. Knowledge of cloud-native deployment and containerization. Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Work Model Work From Office (5 Days Initially). After successful completion of the observation period, the engagement may transition to a hybrid work model based on project requirements and performance.

Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
